diff_summary: The `+` quantifier was dropped from the final substitution: `re.sub(r"[-\s]+", "-", value)` became `re.sub(r"[-\s]", "-", value)`.
why_its_a_bug: Without the quantifier the pattern matches one separator at a time, so each space or hyphen is replaced individually instead of a whole run collapsing into a single hyphen. 'Spaces   everywhere' becomes 'spaces---everywhere'.
hint_level_description: Single-word input and single spaces come out fine. Try an input with several spaces or hyphens in a row and compare it to what the docstring promises.
